skill.summary: Generate videos with Google Veo models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Veo 3.1, Veo 3.1 Fast, Veo 3, Veo 3 Fast, Veo 2. Capabilities: text-to-video, cinematic...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of google-veo skill using inference.sh CLI.
- Supports Google Veo video models: Veo 3.1, Veo 3.1 Fast, Veo 3, Veo 3 Fast, and Veo 2.
- Enables text-to-video generation with options for cinematic, high-quality outputs.
- Includes quick start instructions, example prompts, and tips for effective video creation.
- Provides model comparison table and sample workflow for customizing inputs.
- Lists related video and image generation skills for expanded functionality.
